meta_description:
jackmorris on October 9, 2026: "6 weeks in Barcelona. I booked this apartment with @stayukio and this time more than ever it’s felt like a home away from home.

It’s been the perfect base for working, having friends and family over, and just enjoying everyday city life.

Would definitely recommend it to anyone thinking of calling Barcelona home for a month or more. Until next time!".
